newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy 97 GDP growth seen at 1.2-1.5 pct-Treu.
newsitem.headline: Italy 97 GDP growth seen at 1.2-1.5 pct-Treu.

text.p: Italian Gross Domestic Product (GDP) in 1997 is seen growing between 1.2 and 1.5 percent, Labour Minister Tiziano Treu said on Wednesday.

The government's official GDP growth target for the current year is 2.0 percent following an expected 0.8 percent rise in 1996. It has stuck to the 1997 forecast despite expectations by most economists that GDP will grow just under 1.0 percent.
Treu mentioned the lower forecast at a news conference on pension funds when asked by journalists to comment on the state of the economy.
"I expect this year to be a year of recovery even if it won't be sparkling," Treu said. He did not elaborate.
